title: Decision
description: Judge output selecting accepted, rejected, or uncertain claims.

run_id.description: Reference to the run this decision belongs to.

accepted_claim_ids.description: List of claim IDs accepted by the judge.

rejected_claim_ids.description: List of claim IDs rejected by the judge.

uncertain_claim_ids.description: List of claim IDs the judge could not decide on.

score_breakdown.description: Detailed score breakdown per claim or dimension.

needs_more_debate.description: Whether the judge determined more debate is needed.

extra_debate_reason.description: Reason more debate is needed, or null if not applicable.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata associated with this decision.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this decision was created.
